Compare iPhone 16, Pixel 9 and Galaxy S25 side by side and highlight the best value
7:36 AM

Pixel 9 is the best value of the three: a 120Hz screen, the biggest battery and 7 years of updates at about the same price. The Galaxy S25 is the pick if you want the fastest chip and a zoom camera, and the iPhone 16 if you already use Apple things. These are launch-time specs from memory, and shop prices now vary a lot, so check the current price before you buy.
